title: Bramble Union
kicker: Ragged road figures in scavenged ward-stone scraps who ambush freight and look like the danger the road warnings promised.
hook: The Bramble Union: Thorn-scrap armor, hungry eyes, and old worker gear make the Bramble Union look dangerous before they look human. Slogan: We were the route.

blocks.label: Public Face
blocks.body: Ragged road figures in scavenged ward-stone scraps who ambush freight and look like the danger the road warnings promised.

blocks.label: How To Deal
blocks.body: At first the Bramble Union is all shape and threat: figures in bark-dark cloaks, ward-stone scraps tied over patched shirts, and blades held by people who know exactly how little food waits behind them. Then you see the worker pins, the mended children's...

affordances: Compare their slogan to what they actually do in the scene.
